title: Pacified Mobs
description: Mob Pacifier allows players to tame hostile mobs using a special nametag called "Amigao".
body:
Description
Have you ever wanted a friendly Warden?

Mob Pacifier allows players to tame hostile mobs using a special nametag called "Amigao".

Features
Tame hostile mobs
Works with the Warden
Simple and lightweight
Forge 1.20.1 support
Multiplayer compatible
How to Use
Get a nametag
Rename it to:Amigao
Use the nametag on a hostile mob
Credits
Created by Gabriel.
